Resolves #20624

🌿 A loaded runner can no longer fail the unit job by delaying a 10 ms timer past a 40 ms guess.

The Pointer sensor's touch-arm test (`test/playwright/unit/main/draggable/sensor/Pointer.spec.mjs`) now polls for `drag:start` instead of sleeping a fixed 40 ms after `pointerdown`. It still asserts that holding still past `touchDelay` arms the drag, and its other assertions are unchanged. #20617's run 42530984952 hit this flake, and the unit family fails a run on any flaky test.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one wait in one spec.

Evidence: L2 (the spec, 23/23 three runs in a row locally) → L2 required (AC-1 is test behavior).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `Pointer.spec.mjs`, "holding still past touchDelay arms the drag", now awaits `expect.poll(() => seen['drag:start'].length).toBe(1)` with no fixed sleep. |

## Deltas from ticket
None.

## Test Evidence
`Pointer.spec.mjs` passes 23/23 in three consecutive local runs. All other coverage runs in CI.
